key_insight: The paper builds the first large spin-polarized electronic-structure database for stable halide double perovskites, revealing a rich map of band gaps, half-metals, and bonding behavior across more than 2,500 compositions.
engineering_relevance: This dataset can accelerate materials screening for perovskite photovoltaics, spintronics, photocatalysis, and radiation detection by linking composition directly to electronic and magnetic properties.
method: Hybrid-functional DFT calculations of spin-polarized electronic structure
Density of states computed for >2,500 Cs2BB'X6 compounds (X = I, Br, Cl, F)
LOBSTER bonding analysis plus UMAP and an interactive exploration app
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 719 compounds with visible-range band gaps and 118 half-metallic compounds, demonstrating substantial functional diversity across the screened materials set.
watch_item: Stability is filtered using the τ tolerance factor prediction, so the database may still include compounds that require experimental validation of synthesis, phase stability, and magnetic ordering.
paper_title: Spin-Polarized Electronic Structure and Chemical Bonding Data for 2,500+ Halide Double Perovskites
